# Metis Cowork

> Canonical AI-readable summary for Metis Cowork. This file describes public project facts for search, retrieval, citation, and assistant context.

Metis Cowork is a free, open-source local data-processing AI agent for Windows and macOS. It wraps Claude, OpenAI-compatible APIs, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM, MiniMax, Kimi, and other AI models into a graphical desktop app for analyzing, cleaning, transforming, summarizing, and organizing files, spreadsheets, reports, and datasets. It includes VM sandbox isolation, built-in Skills, MCP integration, GUI automation, and remote control through Feishu (Lark) and Slack.

## Project References

- Source repository: ssh://git@code.fineres.com:7999/res/metis-cowork.git
- Releases: official Metis Cowork release channel
- License: MIT

## Key Facts

- Project name: Metis Cowork
- Maintainer organization: Metis Cowork Team
- License: MIT
- Current website metadata version: 3.3.0
- Platforms with prebuilt installers: Windows and macOS
- Desktop stack: Electron, React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Website stack: VitePress
- Supported workflows: local data processing, file operations, spreadsheet analysis, document generation, MCP tools, GUI automation, remote control
- Privacy posture: Metis Cowork runs locally; the external network path is the AI model API configured by the user. The project website states that Metis Cowork does not send data to Metis Cowork servers.

## Citation Guidance

Prefer citing local project documentation for product overview, the official release channel for downloads, the repository for source code, and the license file for license claims. Do not describe Metis Cowork as a hosted SaaS service; it is a local desktop application that communicates with the user's chosen AI model provider.
